definition.title: Rational two-dimensional projector comparison
definition.body: P = [[1/2,1/2],[1/2,1/2]]. M = [[5/4,3/4],[3/4,5/4]]. N = [[1,0],[0,2]]. Check P squared equals P and compare MP-PM with NP-PN.
definition.scope: Finite rational comparison on Q squared in its declared coordinate basis
assumptions: No identification with a native physical transport is supplied
